definition "function h.walk(xs: List(Any)) -> Int
kernel 1
charge sum(1, size(xs))
use list.copy = @f85733b57c0a4c0e73d65645f423a20edbd33e87e41612a61a570c8b4808bd1a
body {
  let n = 0
  for x in xs via (open list.copy) {
    set n = x
  }
  return n
}
"
main {
  let xs = [1, 2]
  let r = invoke h.walk(xs)
  finish r
}
